mission_02: Excellent! You have implemented three essential GPU memory optimization techniques. The memory manager tracks allocations and monitors fragmentation, gradient checkpointing trades compute for memory by selectively saving and recomputing activations, and mixed precision training halves memory usage for activations and gradients while maintaining numerical stability through FP32 master weights. These techniques are the foundation of large-scale model training: gradient checkpointing enables training models that wouldn't fit in GPU memory, mixed precision doubles effective batch sizes and speeds up computation on Tensor Cores, and careful memory management prevents OOM errors during training. Modern frameworks like PyTorch and JAX combine all three techniques automatically.
